fact: The Internet Society Pulse IXP Tracker lists HubSIX, an exchange point in Dakar, with 6 member ASNs in PeeringDB, 5 of 6 peering at the route server, and 260 Gbps cumulative member port capacity (PeeringDB self-declared data, September 2026).
HubSIX says that in the week of 14 May 2026 the new Senegalese internet exchange point exceeded 2 Gbps of locally exchanged traffic for the first time, with operators, ISPs and CDNs as members.
The African IXP Association's undated list of exchange points, retrieved 2026-11-09, names for Senegal: SENIX and HubSIX, both in Dakar.
